title: Joy without chasing the impression

captions.energy: Following the promise of stronger pleasure

meaning: A vivid shared game can delight you, while the promise of ever stronger pleasure may leave uncertainty instead of satisfaction.
text: A pleasant idea can make a persuasive promise: add a little more beauty and the evening will become unforgettable. The Empress in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps you create tangible enjoyment through colour, flavour, texture and making things. The Devil in energy holds the pull towards a stronger impression, narrowing freedom to decide that something is enough. The Moon in emotions leaves experience uncertain. Even after a lovely result, you may wonder whether you truly enjoyed it. The feeling has yet to become clear while desire already demands continuation.

Imagine inventing costumes for photographs at home. Combining fabrics, trying amusing details and seeing each other in an unfamiliar guise is engaging. **A shared game has value before its impression is finally judged.** Yet another accessory promises a better picture, moving attention forward again. One imperfect photograph may preserve genuine laughter more clearly than a prolonged attempt to create an image that removes every doubt.

The difficulty is answering an unclear feeling by intensifying the activity. More details, a bolder costume, another attempt: surely enjoyment will become certain. You assess the expected impression more often than noticing what happens between you. The pull to continue gains control of the evening. Permission to stop at a moment you liked restores space for feelings to become clearer without another compulsory pleasure.
